title: Aphorism § 178
text:
§ 178



 It will, no doubt, sometimes happen that this medicine, selected in
          strict observance of the homoeopathic law, furnishes the similar artificial disease suited
          for the annihilation of the malady present; and this is much more likely to happen when
          these few morbid symptoms are very striking, decided, uncommon and peculiarly distinctive
          (characteristic).
